ai.notConfiguredDescription: This workspace has no AI provider. Would you like to configure one now?
ai.fallbackNotice: Primary AI provider failed — response served by {{provider}}

changes.noRepoDescription: Select a repository to see uncommitted changes.

discard.renamedDisabled: Renamed files cannot be discarded yet
discard.singleUntrackedDescription: "{{path}}" is not tracked by git — discarding deletes the file from disk permanently.
discard.singleTrackedDescription: Uncommitted changes in "{{path}}" will be restored to the last staged version. This cannot be undone.
discard.multiUntrackedDescription: {{files}} files will be discarded: tracked files are restored to their last staged version and untracked files are deleted from disk permanently. This cannot be undone.
discard.multiTrackedDescription: Uncommitted changes in {{files}} files will be restored to their last staged version. This cannot be undone.

ignore.title: Add to .gitignore
ignore.description: Appends the chosen pattern to the repo-root .gitignore (shared with collaborators). The file stays on disk but leaves the change list if untracked.
ignore.onlyUntrackedDisabled: Only untracked files can be ignored

amend.title: Amend the most recent commit?
amend.description: This rewrites history: staged changes and the edited message will replace your last commit. The previous commit stays recoverable from the Reflog.
amend.pushedWarning: This commit has an upstream — it may already be pushed. Amending will rewrite published history and the next push may be rejected.

stash.title: Stash
stash.applyTooltip: Apply this stash and keep it in the list
stash.popTooltip: Apply this stash, then drop it from the list
stash.dropTooltip: Delete this stash (cannot be undone in the UI)
stash.detailEmptyFiles: This stash has no file changes.
stash.detailNoFileSelectedDescription: Click a file on the left to see its diff.
stash.dirtyDescription_one: {{count}} uncommitted change is present; applying this stash may conflict.
stash.dirtyDescription_other: {{count}} uncommitted changes are present; applying this stash may conflict.
stash.dropConfirmIrreversible: This cannot be undone in the UI.
stash.saveDescription: Save your local changes to a new stash
stash.stageNewFilesHint: By default stash ignores new files until you stage them
